name: Concentrated Fire and Mad Aspect's Scepter raise Cleansing Flames and Destroyer's Maw (#2426, #1283)
contract: #2426, #1283: both passives are ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) on MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), applied through the native spell-mod path (Unit.cpp:9367 for direct damage, :10217 for healing). Concentrated Fire 704864: base 19 -> +20%, class mask {0, 0x8, 0} = Cleansing Flames Heal 681141 and Damage 681142 only. Mad Aspect's Scepter rank 1 706896: base 19 -> +20%; rank 2 707790: base 39 -> +40%; class mask {0x8000000, 0, 0} = Destroyer's Maw 802107 (rank 1) and 502107-502113 (ranks 2-8). No other family-30 spell carries either bit (scanned in the group 4 audit). spell_modifier queries the native SPELLMOD_DAMAGE path on a base of 1000 without casting, so a passive that stops applying, or applies to the wrong spells, fails an assertion. Each control asserts the mask does not leak onto the other passive's spell.

steps.label: Cleansing Flames Damage has no damage modifier before any passive
Destroyer's Maw has no damage modifier before any passive
Concentrated Fire adds 20% to Cleansing Flames Damage
Concentrated Fire adds 20% to Cleansing Flames Heal
Concentrated Fire does not touch Destroyer's Maw
Unlearning Concentrated Fire removes the bonus
Mad Aspect's Scepter rank 1 adds 20% to Destroyer's Maw rank 1
Mad Aspect's Scepter rank 1 adds 20% to a higher Destroyer's Maw rank
Mad Aspect's Scepter does not touch Cleansing Flames Damage
Mad Aspect's Scepter rank 2 adds 40% to Destroyer's Maw rank 1
Mad Aspect's Scepter rank 2 adds 40% to a higher Destroyer's Maw rank
Rank 2 replaced rank 1 instead of stacking on it (still 40%, not 60%)
